rules: Characters are generated because a live-world staffing/population need exists, not because the player asks for a person.
Generated characters persist once individually materialized.
Rank, profession and faction constrain role/knowledge/authority but do not fully determine personality.
Initial relationships require a plausible pre-existing shared context.
Background populations may use aggregate LOD until an individual becomes relevant.
LOD promotion preserves pre-existing identity and history.
Canonical characters are generated only from canonical definitions, never by generic random generation.
